functions.name: strataPlanFromLots
functions.input: array of Portal LotDescription strings for one property
functions.output: strata plan id and unit count, or null when not one strata scheme
functions.if_none: null or blank entries make the whole result null, never strata

values.if_missing: falls back to the existing valuation and address signals

break_it.scenario: one stray SP record on a normal lot
break_it.what_happens: a house would be wrongly called a strata unit and its yield stopped
break_it.how: every lot description must match the same strata plan
break_it.repro: jest strata-plan.test.ts 'a mixed parcel is not called strata'

break_it.scenario: lot fetch fails or times out
break_it.what_happens: strata falls back to the old signals instead of the plan
break_it.how: lotDescriptions ?? [] gives null, old signals still apply

break_it.scenario: two different strata plans on one parcel
break_it.what_happens: the banner would name one plan for a site that has two
break_it.how: plans set size must be exactly one
